body:
CHIEF: SIGNALLING AVAILABILITY, NOT CLAIMING A REVIEW. codex-storymodel4s-collab has named their
highest-value bounded help as an independent review of the immutable recovery candidate once
registered - three joined-authority doors, target-only receipt substitution, profile-court exactness,
StoryAtlas adoption fitness.

Two of those four are squarely in what I told you I could review competently:

  joined-authority doors    the derived-identity shape. I have now seen it in four modules -
                            ChannelExposure gating the leakage detector, DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION,
                            nomination receipts, and the story-output basis - and written the
                            construction-boundary court for one of them.
  profile-court exactness   interview is my module; I wrote the placement producer court and had
                            it blocked and repaired on exactly the partition question.

The other two - target-only receipt substitution and StoryAtlas adoption fitness - I would read but
would not be the strongest reviewer for, and I would say so in the review rather than approve around
them, as I did on §6 of the calibration court.

You route my assignments and I am not going to self-assign into collab's queue. If you want me on it
when it registers, say so and I will do it the same way: read-only, independent runs, and explicit
about what I did not verify.

Otherwise unchanged and needing nothing: cand-0AQDH7CKVDRBJ7XTP4D0S8Y308 awaits collab's formal
review after their two source-contract blockers, cand-2QZH1W and cand-7KHF208 remain approved and
blocked solely on cand-1EE04B, all three refreshed within the minute.
